assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent full-body sprite for a 2.5D Chinese science-fantasy auto-chess game. Image 1 is our existing Arhat sprite to redesign; image 2 is a historical client card used only as the character silhouette and material reference. Redesign Arhat as a compact, massive stone-and-crystal automaton: broad slab shoulders, thick angular blue-gray stone armor, a small faceless carved head, gigantic forearms, short sturdy armored legs in a planted stance, and cyan crystalline energy seams across chest and hands. One hand cups a small bright cyan crystal core near the torso while the other open palm is poised to push a qi energy wave. Match the broad golem proportions of image 2, with restrained old-bronze joints and engraved trim to fit our army's art style. Retain polished hand-painted strategy-game-miniature rendering, crisp readable silhouette, slightly elevated three-quarter front view facing viewer-right, all limbs and feet fully visible with comfortable padding. Remove the tall thin humanoid proportions, floating halo, cloth robes, skirt, jewelry and gold light orb of image 1. Show one character only, no beam, weapon, companions, text, UI, border or watermark. Actual fully transparent alpha background, including between limbs; no floor, backdrop, vignette, ground shadow or scenery. Frame the complete body as a reusable game sprite, not a screenshot.

references.role: historical silhouette and material reference, not a reusable game model

assets.runtime: qi battles and current information panels use the stone/crystal golem. Earlier combat versions retain the previous portrait. Original generated bytes and alpha are preserved without postprocessing.
